note: Measurement semantics and operating limits for the laboratory. Limits are derived from the recorded simulation configuration (evidence/backend-loss/04-edge-config-discovery.json), not from hardware datasheets. All channels derive from the same simulator clock and equations; the zero-residual check is therefore a consistency check, not an independent measurement.
time_source: host UTC; no independent clock verification
balance_tolerance_rationale: Read by src/energy_assurance/cli.py; the code carries no separate copy of this value.

sign_convention.ess_w: positive = discharge to the site, negative = charge
sign_convention.residual_definition: production + ess + grid - consumption, expected 0 within tolerance (grid import positive)

channels.limit_note: min equals -operating_limits.ess_max_charge_w, max equals operating_limits.ess_max_discharge_w; tests assert agreement
No grid connection limit was recorded for the simulator.
equals operating_limits.soc_floor_pct and soc_ceiling_pct; tests assert agreement

validation.note: Read by src/energy_assurance/cli.py. Per-channel min, max and finite live on the channel entries above; the required snapshot fields are the channel 'field' names.
validation.transition_tolerance_rationale: Two adjacent samples that are each balanced within balance_tolerance_w may differ in residual by up to twice that value; a larger unexplained change in ess_w is a transition.
validation.max_gap_rationale: Equal to stale_after_s of the power channels. A longer gap between adjacent trace samples can hide a transition, so SC-03 becomes INCONCLUSIVE.

evidence_formats.1: Four phase snapshots (pre_failure, outage_discharge, outage_charge, recovery), each with captured_at_utc and the five channel fields. Sufficient for SC-01, SC-02, SC-04 and SC-05. SC-03 is INCONCLUSIVE because two balanced snapshots cannot show the absence of transitions between them.
evidence_formats.2: Format 1 plus evidence_format = 2 and a state_trace: either an inline list of sample objects or state_trace_file naming a JSONL file next to the run file (one sample object per line). Each sample carries captured_at_utc and/or source_timestamp, optional monotonic_s, the five channel fields, and optionally grid_setpoint_w and backend_link_18081.

time_semantics.source_timestamp: Time stamped by the producing system (edge or simulator) for the sample. Absent from format 1 evidence; no value is invented for old snapshots.
time_semantics.captured_at_utc: Host wall-clock time (UTC, aware ISO-8601) at which the evidence collector read the value. Present in all recorded evidence.
time_semantics.monotonic_s: Host monotonic counter in seconds. Used for gap measurement between adjacent samples when present; never compared with wall-clock time or across hosts.
time_semantics.clock_uncertainty_note: Not measured. Host UTC without independent verification; no bound is claimed, so the code uses 0 s and a source_timestamp later than captured_at_utc is an evidence error.
time_semantics.freshness_rule: captured_at_utc minus source_timestamp must not exceed the smallest stale_after_s among the required channels. Enforced only when both timestamps are present on the same record.

operating_limits.soc_limit_note: The simulated ESS enforces no configured reserve floor above 0%. Expected behaviour at a SOC limit is power limitation with non-zero grid exchange; that outcome would be correct behaviour, not a failure (planned EXP-06).
